summary_en: MBK Co., Ltd. reported zero shares acquired in September 2026 under its buyback program authorized on December 12, 2025. Cumulative acquisitions reached 3,514,700 shares for ¥785.93 million as of September 30, 2026, representing 10.7% of outstanding shares, against an authorization ceiling of 4.1 million shares (13.4%) for ¥820 million through December 11, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Progress Status of Matters Related to Acquisition of Own Stock
translation_en_brief: MBK Co., Ltd. disclosed on October 1, 2026, the progress of its buyback program authorized by board resolutions dated December 12, 2025, and May 18, 2026. During September 2026, the company acquired zero shares. As of September 30, 2026, cumulative acquisitions under the program totaled 3,514,700 shares for ¥785,928,000, representing 10.7% of outstanding shares (calculated as 3,514,700 shares divided by 32,806,190 minus 2,058,325 self-held shares). The authorization ceiling is 4,100,000 shares (13.4% of outstanding shares) for a maximum aggregate amount of ¥820,000,000, with the acquisition period running through December 11, 2026. The buyback is conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
